title: Document Set Completeness
content: The application form, payslip, and bank statement are required before document review is complete. Request any missing item.

title: Missing Application Form
content: If the application form is missing, request the completed form before continuing review.

title: Missing Payslip
content: If the payslip is missing, request it before checking name, employer, or payslip income.

title: Missing Bank Statement
content: If the bank statement is missing, request transaction history before relying on bank salary checks.

title: Complete Document Set
content: A complete document set allows the remaining checks to be considered; completeness alone does not establish eligibility.

title: Applicant Name Mismatch
content: If the application and payslip names differ, refer the discrepancy for manual review.

title: Identity Check Pending Payslip
content: When the payslip is absent, obtain it and rerun the applicant name comparison.
actions: Rerun the applicant name comparison after the payslip is provided.

title: Applicant Name Matched
content: A matching application and payslip name resolves the name comparison only; other checks remain independent.

title: Employer Name Mismatch
content: If the application and payslip employer names do not match after normalization, refer the discrepancy for manual review.

title: Employer Check Pending Payslip
content: When the payslip is absent, request it before accepting an employer match.

title: Employer Name Matched
content: A normalized employer name match resolves the employer comparison but does not verify income.

title: Payslip Income Difference Above Ten Percent
content: If payslip income differs from declared income by more than 10% and no more than 15%, request supporting income evidence.
actions: Request supporting evidence for the payslip income discrepancy.

title: Payslip Income Difference Above Fifteen Percent
content: If payslip income differs from declared income by more than 15%, refer the discrepancy for manual review.

title: Bank Income Difference Above Ten Percent
content: If the bank salary average differs from declared income by more than 10% and no more than 15%, request supporting income evidence.
actions: Request supporting evidence for the bank income discrepancy.

title: Bank Income Difference Above Fifteen Percent
content: If the bank salary average differs from declared income by more than 15%, refer the discrepancy for manual review.

title: Bank Salary Average Unavailable
content: If no bank salary average is available, request transaction history showing salary deposits before treating bank income as verified.

title: Payslip Income Check Passed
content: A passed payslip income check means the amount is within the configured 10% tolerance; bank salary remains a separate check.

title: Bank Income Check Passed
content: A passed bank income check means the salary average is within the configured 10% tolerance; this is not a lending decision.

title: Short Salary History
content: If salary deposits appear in fewer than three distinct months, request additional salary history before relying on income stability.

title: Salary History Check Passed
content: Salary deposits in at least three distinct months satisfy the history check; amounts require a separate income comparison.

title: Identity or Employer Escalation
content: A material name or employer mismatch requires a human reviewer to resolve the discrepancy.
actions: Refer the identity or employer discrepancy to a human reviewer.

title: Income Escalation
content: An income discrepancy above the configured 15% threshold requires manual review; generated guidance alone cannot resolve it.
actions: Refer the income discrepancy to a human reviewer.
